system.description:
You launch your weapons that are lined with your battle wires surrounding a target creature before you pull back snapping the wire, constricting them. Target creature must make a Strength saving throw, being Restrained for the duration, on a failure. Affected creature remakes their saving throw at the end of each of their turns, breaking free on a success.

Chain 1: You treat the target creature(s) as the center of a 5-foot radius assault. All creatures within the affected radius must make their saving throw against this jutsu’s effects.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above D-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3 and the number of creatures you can target by +1
